slides.subtitle: One afternoon, before the holidays get loud.

slides.heading: Chase what's open
slides.body: List every unpaid invoice. Send one friendly reminder now, not in the last week of December.

slides.heading: Check your tax pot
slides.body: Is enough set aside for what you'll owe? Better to know in November than to be surprised in spring.

slides.heading: Decide on Black Friday
slides.body: A discount, a gift, or nothing at all. Choose calmly now, so you don't panic-discount later.

slides.heading: Review your prices
slides.body: Did your work get better this year? Your rates for next year can reflect that.
